dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 10, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Power Play: Home Runs Fly as Multiple Stars Shine in MLB Action**

In a day filled with explosive home runs, Caleb Durbin stole the show with his pair of long balls, leading the Boston Red Sox in a losing effort against the Tampa Bay Rays. Durbin's 3-for-4 day included a pair of home runs, driving in two runs for Boston. On the mound, Drew Rasmussen dominated for Tampa Bay, tossing 7 scoreless innings with 13 strikeouts to earn the win.

Meanwhile, Austin Hedges doubled for the Cleveland Guardians in their 8-4 loss to the New York Yankees. Carlos Rodón was impressive for the Yankees, going 6 strong innings with 7 strikeouts.

In the nightcap, Bryce Eldridge hit a grand slam for the San Francisco Giants in their 10-11 win over the Washington Nationals. Matt Chapman also went deep twice for the Giants, driving in three runs.

In the late games, Fernando Tatis Jr. continued his power surge with a home run for the San Diego Padres in their 4-5 win over the Cincinnati Reds. Brady Singer pitched 6 strong innings for the Reds, striking out 5.

In other games, Jackson Holliday hit a home run for the Baltimore Orioles in their 7-2 win over the Seattle Mariners. George Kirby pitched 6 innings for the Mariners, striking out 10. Tyler Callihan had a big day for the Pittsburgh Pirates in their 9-8 win over the Los Angeles Dodgers, hitting two home runs. Shohei Ohtani pitched 6.2 innings for the Dodgers, striking out 6.

In the other results, Byron Buxton hit a home run for the Minnesota Twins in their 6-4 win over the Detroit Tigers. Travis Adams pitched 1.1 scoreless innings for the Twins, striking out 3. Jake Burger hit a home run for the Texas Rangers in their 6-4 win over the Kansas City Royals. MacKenzie Gore pitched 5 innings for the Rangers, striking out 6.
